convert_io_to_qas_format: convert a line-delimited JSON input-output file into a QAS format with question and answers fields
transform_json_with_questions_and_answer: transform JSON lines data by extracting input as question and output answers into a new format
extract_answers_from_output: extract non-null answer values from output arrays in JSON lines and add them as a new answers field
add_question_field_from_input: add a question field derived from the input field of each JSON line record
process_jsonl_with_tqdm: process a JSONL file line by line with a progress bar and write transformed output to a new file
